issue.title: dismissed-bundle index keeps SCHEMA_VERSION 1 after the meta_changespec -> meta_patch rename, so legacy indexes fail with 'no such column: meta_patch'
issue.description: Phase sase-hn.8.2 (commit 50f8961ac) renamed the dismissed_bundle_summaries column meta_changespec to meta_patch but left SCHEMA_VERSION at 1. Verified on master today: src/sase/ace/dismissed_bundle_index/_models.py:7 still has SCHEMA_VERSION = 1, while _schema.py:140/156 create and index the meta_patch column. _ensure_schema (_schema.py:55) only drops and rebuilds when the stored version differs from SCHEMA_VERSION, and _create_schema uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, so an existing version-1 index.sqlite written before the rename is accepted as current, the old table survives, and _create_indexes then fails with sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: meta_patch. IMPACT (as originally reported by sase-i2.land, reproduced from a temporary legacy-v1 database): live phase commits reached origin, but post-primary agent sync/commit publication and both 'sase_git_commit --resume' and 'sase commit --resume' reported 'No item with that key' until the stale cache was manually reset. Epic sase-hn.8 was closed 2026-08-11 with this recorded as unresolved residue. SCOPE: bump/migrate the schema version or structurally validate the columns, and add a same-version legacy-column regression so old indexes self-heal.
